displayNameNote: working name; the product name is not final
domainNote: not chosen yet; the owner picks it in P02 (staging app.staging.<domain>, api.staging.<domain>); production uses the same zone in P04
commercialNote: paid SaaS sold globally (per-word service tiers, Agency OS), so no noncommercial-licensed tool may be used

repo.topologyNote: one git repo holding a monorepo: services/api (Python 3.13, FastAPI) and apps/web (Next.js 16). The root package.json only carries the control plane and the cross-platform ship check; no npm workspaces.

node.note: the owner's machine has fnm with 24 as default. Move to 26 in the first phase that starts after the upgrade window, never mid-phase.

python.note: doctor checks only Node; npm run check:runtime (first step of npm run verify) checks the venv Python against .python-version

postgres.local: docker compose -f deploy/docker-compose.dev.yml (pgvector/pgvector:pg16), databases arbiter and arbiter_test

storagePolicy.reason: The owner's C: drive is nearly full. Repo, npm and uv caches, Python installs, Playwright browsers, Docker data, Graphify output and measurement artifacts all live on E:.
storagePolicy.doctorBehaviour: warn until P00 records the real path, then fail on drift
storagePolicy.currentNote: Path of the cloud build session. P00 replaces it with the real Windows path after the clone.

locales.note: English-first product (D-045). More UI locales are added without a deploy by exporting the English catalog and importing translations (JSON, CSV, XLIFF) into the database (D-046); they fall back to English. The Serbian content in the repo is measurement and test data only.

excludedNote: payments (Paddle, payout rails) and email (queued SMTP) are built on mocks and go live in P03 and P02. Product analytics and errors run through PostHog EU with privacy mode as part of observability (plannedHosting.observability), not as a separate capability.

tools.cliNote: Provider work goes through these CLIs or the providers' REST APIs before any browser step is asked of the owner (CLAUDE.md law 2). Cloudflare, Better Stack and PostHog are driven through their REST APIs with scoped tokens.

canonicalTruth.note: Hooks and the Beads export are project truth and are tracked. Local tool binaries, .cursor/mcp.json, env files and graphify-out/ are not.

gates.note: Core 1.0.0 refuses to write attested records (no CI signer yet). Every phase uses gateKind phase, so replayable is the bar. Attested is declared for when CI build provenance exists. The gate runs `npm run verify` with a 900 s limit; e2e is separate (npm run verify:e2e) and enters a gate through ledger records.
